sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Anti-FLAG immunostaining without membrane permeabilization confirmed cell-surface display of the full-length receptor in LNCaP cells (surface_only; no functional assay result stated in the cited clip).
sites.rationale: OR51E1 has no endogenous signal peptide; residues 1–27 are extracellular and the N-terminus is the only extracellular terminus available for a prepend. Python confirmed residue 1 = M and TM1 begins at residue 28, giving 27 residues of extracellular space — well above the 3-residue minimum. The Lucy SP is cleaved, so the FLAG is the first element of the mature surface-displayed protein. Position is topology-derived because no residue number is cited. Full-length OR51E1 expressed in LNCaP cells using an inducible tetracycline system. Construct architecture (L2): exogenous Lucy signal peptide (17 aa, cleavable) + FLAG epitope + 20 N-terminal aa of rhodopsin + OR51E1(1–318). After Lucy cleavage the mature surface protein begins with FLAG, placing it on the extracellular face before OR51E1 residue 1 (M). No residue number is stated; OR51E1 has no endogenous signal peptide and its sole extracellular terminus is the N-terminus (residues 1–27, 27 aa before TM1 at residue 28), so the junction is topology-derived.

sources.claim: LNCaP–OR51E1tet cells were grown either without or with 1 μg/ml doxycycline for 2 days, then fixed, stained with the anti-FLAG antibody ( red ) without cell membrane permeabilization and analyzed by open-field microscopy.

The antibody specificity was demonstrated by co-immunocytochemical staining of Hana3A cells heterologously expressing rho-tagged OR51E1 (see supplementary Figure S1A) and by using of a specific OR51E1-blocking peptide (Figure S2).

literature_notes: All six ledger lines converge on the N-terminal extracellular prepend (insert_after_residue = 0). L1–L4 (PMC8024707, PMC13034504) describe the Lucy-FLAG-Rho20-OR51E1 construct; L5–L6 (PMC5258789, PMC5217014) describe the rho-tagged OR51E1 construct. No ledger line names a specific residue number, so both sites are topology_derived. OR51E1 has no endogenous signal peptide (raw topology string contains no 'S'; residue 1 is extracellular). The three shorter extracellular loops (ECL1: 90–100, 11 aa; ECL2: 167–196, 30 aa with three conserved Cys at 172/182/192; ECL3: 264–275, 12 aa) are not supported by any ledger insertion and are not proposed. ECL2 contains multiple disulfide-forming cysteines typical of class-A GPCRs, making internal insertions there particularly risky even if evidence existed.
